blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The New NAIA Infra Corp. (NNIC) is anticipating at least 144,000 passengers at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) on Monday, All Souls’ Day. This is on top of the 868,423 passengers recorded from October 27 to November 1, which will push the total number of travelers using the country’s primary airport to over 1 million before the end of the Undas season. “Based on the projection of NNIC-AICCC (Airport Integrated Command and Control Center) passenger traffic is expected to reach at least 144,000 today,” the Manila International Airport Authority (MIAA) said in a text message to the […]...
